record.original_question: For the Airy integral operator A_s on L^2(s, infinity), whose Fredholm determinant gives the edge-scaling distribution for the largest GUE eigenvalue, can one analyze the eigenfunctions u_tilde_j(s) asymptotically as s tends to infinity and also compute them accurately for finite s?

evidence.quote: It is an open problem to analyze the behavior of the eigenfunctions u_tilde_j(s) as s -> infinity, and to compute their behavior for finite s.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathrm{Ai}(x)$ denote the Airy function, and define the Airy kernel
$$K_{\mathrm{Ai}}(x,y)=\frac{\mathrm{Ai}(x)\,\mathrm{Ai}'(y)-\mathrm{Ai}'(x)\,\mathrm{Ai}(y)}{x-y},\qquad K_{\mathrm{Ai}}(x,x)=\mathrm{Ai}'(x)^2-x\,\mathrm{Ai}(x)^2.$$
For each real number $s$, let $\mathcal A_s$ be the integral operator on $L^2(s,\infty)$ with kernel $K_{\mathrm{Ai}}(x,y)$. The operator $\mathcal A_s$ is trace class, self-adjoint, and positive with eigenvalues $1>\lambda_0(s)>\lambda_1(s)>\cdots>0$ and corresponding $L^2(s,\infty)$-normalized eigenfunctions $\tilde u_j(\,\cdot\,;s)$, $j=0,1,2,\dots$, satisfying
$$\int_s^\infty K_{\mathrm{Ai}}(x,y)\,\tilde u_j(y;s)\,dy=\lambda_j(s)\,\tilde u_j(x;s),\qquad x>s.$$
The Fredholm determinant $\det(I-\mathcal A_s)$ equals the Tracy–Widom distribution $F_2(s)$ governing the edge-scaling limit of the largest eigenvalue of the Gaussian Unitary Ensemble.

Problem. (a) Determine the asymptotic behavior of the eigenfunctions $\tilde u_j(x;s)$ as $s\to+\infty$, for each fixed $j\ge 0$, including leading-order asymptotics, dependence on $x-s$, and decay properties. (b) Provide a method, with rigorous error bounds, for computing $\tilde u_j(x;s)$ accurately for finite real values of $s$ (including large negative $s$).
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work (Bremer, Rokhlin, and collaborators) has produced spectral algorithms for the eigendecomposition of the Airy integral operator, exploiting a commuting differential operator due to Tracy–Widom, that compute the eigenfunctions $\tilde u_j(\cdot;s)$ to near machine precision for finite $s$. Asymptotic analyses of related Fredholm determinants and tails as $s\to\pm\infty$ exist (e.g., Deift–Its–Krasovsky), but a complete rigorous asymptotic description of the eigenfunctions themselves as $s\to\infty$ is not fully established in the literature found. The problem thus appears partially solved: the numerical computation aspect is largely resolved, while the asymptotic analysis is only partly addressed.

status_evidence.title: On the evaluation of the eigendecomposition of the Airy integral operator
status_evidence.snippet: Spectral algorithms for the eigendecomposition of the Airy integral operator that can be used to rapidly evaluate Tracy–Widom distributions to machine accuracy.
status_evidence.claim: Finite-$s$ accurate computation of eigenfunctions has been developed.

status_evidence.title: Algebras of Commuting Differential Operators for Kernels of Airy Type
status_evidence.snippet: Commuting differential operators sharing eigenfunctions with the Airy integral operator, used to derive asymptotic expansions.
status_evidence.claim: A bispectral commuting ODE is available, aiding asymptotic analysis.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotics of Tracy-Widom distributions and the total integral of a Painlevé II function
status_evidence.snippet: Rigorous asymptotics for the Tracy-Widom distribution as s tends to infinity.
status_evidence.claim: Determinant asymptotics are known, but eigenfunction asymptotics are less explicit.
